assets.prompt: Create a production pixel-art character animation sprite atlas using the attached portrait as the exact identity reference. Preserve its silhouette, palette, face, markings and proportions. Crisp hard pixel edges. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no grid lines. EXACTLY 10 equal columns and 8 equal rows = 80 separate full-body poses. Leave a wide transparent gutter between EVERY sprite. All poses identical scale and feet baseline within each equal cell, entire body fits inside its cell. Each row is ONE fixed camera direction. Rows top to bottom: SOUTH front, SOUTHEAST front-right three-quarter, EAST right profile, NORTHEAST back-right three-quarter, NORTH back (NO FACE), NORTHWEST back-left three-quarter, WEST left profile, SOUTHWEST front-left three-quarter. Columns left to right in EVERY row: idle neutral; idle breathing; walk left step; walk right step; basic attack anticipation; basic attack contact/release; special ability charge; special ability release; dying stagger; collapsed defeat. Draw real changes to limbs and posture, not copies translated/rotated. Rear views show the back, not a second face. No enemies. Do not bake flying projectiles into the sprites. Character and attack specifics: Magenta batlike alien, huge yellow slitted eyes, wide pointed ears, ivory crest and chin patch. Basic: electric ray from hands. Special: opens arms and channels electricity with fierce pose; localized small purple sparks near hands.
